title: The founder is the brand.
metaDesc: For small studios and small brands, the founder's presence is the most under-used asset.

texts.text: For small studios and small brands, the founder's presence is the most under-used asset.

Every small brand under-uses its founder. Every small studio does too. Here is why the founder's presence, story, and voice are the most under-leveraged asset in most emerging brands, and what we do on every Mira project to bring the founder back to the surface of the work.

We work with founders who spend six figures on a rebrand and then refuse to appear anywhere on the site. Their story is the reason the business exists. Their point of view is what the customer is actually buying. And yet the About page shows a stock photo of a laptop on a wooden desk and a paragraph of corporate we-language.

texts.text: A candle brand from Savannah is more compelling because a real person in Savannah is pouring the candles.
